static_caveats: README direct-run calls .local but run_training requires modal.current_function_call_id: static contradiction, not runtime reproduction.
Staff Modal namespace, W&B entity, Tailscale/proxy/internal API reporting and PostgreSQL remain external dependencies.

TrainingConfig runtime has lower bound only; /submit enforces remaining 12h budget; /final_submission persists predictions, not exploration jobs. Worker decorator remains 12h; final48h deployment not established by inspected source.
Fixed DCLM order is an API protocol; data builder references dataset @main and tokenizer without fixed revision. Rebuilding byte-identical remote data is not established.
No blanket MIT rights to dataset/tokenizer/models/papers/services.
